top_choice_rationale: Pd-catalyzed C-N coupling is one coherent, mechanistically understood achievement (ligand-controlled oxidative addition, amine binding, reductive elimination) with 25-30 years of independent confirmation and industrial use. Buchwald and Hartwig independently built the ligand families that made it general, so the two-name allocation follows the real history without trimming. The overlap with the 2010 cross-coupling prize and the Kosugi/Migita precursor are real judgements, but the citation can be worded around the general catalytic method. P004 (Car-Parrinello) is nearly as clean but follows the 1998 and 2013 computational prizes. P001 is scientifically strong but its three-name cut across the PROTAC and cereblon strands omits Sakamoto and Ciulli, and P003 carries two uncertain credit boundaries (Wang/Mehl/Yokoyama; Nishida/Kondo plus the 2020 CRISPR prize).
